inherited.problem: 「赞成一方在史料里只留下这一句判断」与证据不符：E3记有论者一方的整段理由（岁糜数百万此漏卮、竭天下力赡西军无以待不虞、宜徇英人议许帕夏自立称籓），且与本文开头段引用的正是这些理由，自相矛盾；未记具体论据的只是李鸿章个人
inherited.suggestion: 改为：传记未记鸿章本人的具体论据，赞成一方的理由在史料中仅存「论者多言」一段概述

inherited.problem: 列举纪年「光绪元年、二年、三年、六年」漏掉四年，正文「四年正月，宗棠条上新疆建行省事宜」用到四年
inherited.suggestion: 改为「原文纪年用光绪元年、二年、三年、四年、六年」

inherited.problem: The English sentence ends with a truncated phrase: "the foreigners began to tell the story about" — the verb has no object, so the claim (外国乃稍稍传说之, that foreigners began spreading word of him/it) is left incomplete.
inherited.suggestion: Change to "the foreigners began to spread the word about him."

contamination.brief_line: - 以金顺出精河为东路，张曜沿特克斯河为中路，锦棠经布鲁特游牧为西路，分遣谭上连等分屯喀什噶尔、阿克苏、哈密为后路声援，合马步卒四万余人（QSG4121-E16）。
- 始西征，虑各行省协助饷不时至，请一借贷外国，诏拨款五百万、敕自借外债五百万（QSG4121-E20）；出塞凡二十月而新疆南北城尽复，为馈运饶给之力（QSG4121-E19）。
注意：以下摘录的锚点未通过逐字核对，已删除，不得使用其内容：QSG4121-E16、QSG4121-E20。

issues.problem: 英文把「高宗」直接写成 the Qianlong emperor，又把关陇注为 the Gansu–Shaanxi corridor。这两处对应关系都不在证据包内，属于证据之外的具体事实。

evidence.quote: 論者多言自高宗定新疆

issues.proposed: 英文改为 'Since the emperor Gaozong took Xinjiang'，并删去 'the Gansu–Shaanxi corridor' 这一注释。
issues.rationale: 英文把 the Qianlong emperor 改为 the emperor Gaozong，与原文「高宗」直接对应；删去证据之外的地理注释 the Gansu–Shaanxi corridor。

issues.problem: 「钱只有这么多，先停哪一头，得当场回答」/'There was only so much money… demanded an answer on the spot' 是作者的框定，证据没有记载。这一句写在 record 段里，又没有标为解释。
issues.proposed: 删去该句，或改为「作者认为，这等于要在两头之间先做取舍」/'As the author sees it, this forced a choice between the two'。
issues.rationale: record 段中“钱只有这么多……得当场回答”一句是作者框定，证据未载。中英两版都已删去该句，其余引文保持不变。

issues.problem: 英文给「帕夏」加注 'a title, roughly governor'，给「和碩伯克」加注 'or clan chief'。这两项释义都不在证据中。

evidence.quote: 本安集延部之和碩伯克也

issues.proposed: 删去这两处释义，只保留音译 'Pasha' 和 'hoşbeg'。
issues.rationale: 删去 'a title, roughly governor' 和 'or clan chief' 两处证据外的释义，只保留 Pasha 与 hoşbeg。

issues.problem: 原文是「且言將代取烏魯木齊」，「代取」指俄方声称代为攻取。中文改成「乌鲁木齐也在其口头计划之内」，英文写成 'would take Ürümqi too'，都抹掉了「代」字，把它写成了俄国自己的占地计划。
issues.proposed: 中文改为「且言将代取乌鲁木齐」，删去「也在其口头计划之内」；英文改为 'and said it would take Ürümqi on China's behalf'。
issues.rationale: 中文恢复为“且言将代取乌鲁木齐”，删去“也在其口头计划之内”；英文改为 said it would also take Ürümqi on China's behalf，保留“代”字的意思。

issues.problem: 「到光绪元年，伊犁已在俄国手中」/'By the first year of Guangxu' 把时间点写成了定论。原文只作「當是時」，并未系年。

evidence.quote: 當是時，俄以回數擾其邊境，遽引兵逐回，取伊犁

issues.proposed: 改为「传记记为『当是时』，未系具体年份」/'The biography dates this only as "at that time"'。
issues.rationale: 删去“到光绪元年”这一系年断言，改为说明传记只记「當是時」、未系具体年份，英文同步修改。

issues.problem: 「海上一旦有事将无以应对」/'if trouble came at sea' 把「不虞」限定成了海上之事，原文泛指不测。
issues.proposed: 中文改为「一旦有不虞之事将无以应对」；英文改为 'nothing would be left to meet the unforeseen'。
issues.rationale: “海上一旦有事”改为“一旦有不虞之事”，英文改为 if anything unforeseen came, nothing would be left to meet it，不再把不虞限定为海上之事。

issues.problem: 证据只作「鴻章」，英文补出了姓氏 Li Hongzhang，这超出了证据。
issues.proposed: 英文改为 'Hongzhang' 并注明原文只称其名，或删去姓氏。
issues.rationale: 英文去掉证据外的姓氏 Li，改作 Hongzhang，并注明原文只称其名。

issues.problem: 「反驳不在道德，而在账」/'arithmetic, not moral' 是作者判断，没有标为解释。而且原话里本有「挫國威」这一非财务理由，与「不在道德」的说法并不完全相符。

evidence.quote: 無益海防而挫國威，且長亂

issues.proposed: 改为「作者认为，他的反驳重心在账上」/'One reading is that his answer rested chiefly on cost'。
issues.rationale: “不在道德，而在账”改为明确标注的作者解释：作者认为反驳重心在账上，并承认原话也有「挫國威」这一非财务理由。英文同步为 One reading is that... rested chiefly on cost。

issues.problem: 英文概述漏了中文所含的「坐自遗患」和「帕夏守不住则归英入俄」两层意思。英文译文 'Instead of recovering' 也漏译了「不及時」。

evidence.quote: 不及時規還國家舊所沒地

issues.proposed: 英文概述补上 'storing up trouble, and the land would fall to England or Russia if Pasha failed'；译文改为 'Instead of recovering in good time the lands…'。
issues.rationale: 英文概述补上“坐自遗患”与“帕夏守不住则归英入俄”两层意思；译文改为 Instead of recovering in good time，补出“不及時”。

issues.problem: 英文 'The dispute ended quickly' 是时长判断，证据未记，中文「结局很短」也没有这层意思。另外 'rather than disband' 误译了「不罷兵」，原意是不停兵。
issues.proposed: 改为 'The record of how it ended is brief'，并把 'rather than disband' 改为 'rather than halt the campaign'。
issues.rationale: 英文改为 The record of how it ended is brief，中文同步改为“关于争论如何收场，传记记得很简短”，去掉时长判断；'rather than disband' 改为 'rather than halt the campaign'。

issues.problem: 英文 'The minister at Khüree, in Urga' 加了地名对应注释，证据只作「庫倫大臣」。

evidence.quote: 適庫倫大臣上言西事宜畫定疆界

issues.proposed: 改为 'The minister at Kulun (Khüree)'，删去 'in Urga'。
issues.rationale: 删去证据外的地名对应 Khüree 与 Urga，只按「庫倫大臣」作 The minister at Kulun。

issues.problem: 原文顺序是：何步云降，伯克胡里纳白彦虎后攻汉城，大军至后遁走俄，然后西四城相继下。稿中把遁走俄移到西四城下之后，并略去了伯克胡里攻汉城一事。原文遁走俄的主语是伯克胡里，稿中明写白彦虎同逃，属于推断。

evidence.quote: 伯克胡里既納白彥虎，乃效力攻漢城。大軍至，复遁走俄。西四城相繼下

issues.proposed: 按原序改为「何步云以喀什汉城降；伯克胡里既纳白彦虎，攻汉城，大军至，遁走俄；西四城相继下」，英文同步调整。
issues.rationale: 按原文顺序重排为：何步云降，伯克胡里纳白彦虎后攻汉城，大军至后遁走俄，然后西四城相继下。补出伯克胡里攻汉城一事；遁走俄的主语只写伯克胡里，删去白彦虎同逃的推断。中英同步。

issues.problem: 英文首句 'Set side by side, the two lines show one test' 直接写成断言。中文对应句以「作者推断」开头，英文缺少这一标注。
issues.proposed: 英文改为 'The author's inference is that, set side by side, the two lines show one test…'。
issues.rationale: 英文首句加上 The author's inference is that，与中文的“作者推断”一致。

issues.problem: 英文把「全權大臣」译为 'An Imperial Commissioner'。该词稿中已用来对应左宗棠的「欽差大臣」，这样会混淆两种官职。

evidence.quote: 詔遣全權大臣崇厚使俄

issues.proposed: 改为 'A plenipotentiary, Chonghou, was sent to Russia'。
issues.rationale: 「全權大臣」改译为 A plenipotentiary envoy，与左宗棠的 Imperial Commissioner（欽差大臣）区分开。

issues.problem: 英文 'meaning to die on campaign' 替左宗棠补写了动机，证据只记「輿櫬」。这也与 limits.0 所称「没有补写心理动机」相矛盾。
issues.proposed: 删去 'meaning to die on campaign'。
issues.rationale: 删去证据外补写的动机 'meaning to die on campaign'，只保留 carrying his coffin。

issues.problem: 英文把「願弱」译为 'the willing and the weak'。「願」在此当谨厚、朴弱讲，并非「愿意」。
issues.proposed: 改为 'settling the meek and the weak on the land'。
issues.rationale: 「願弱」改译为 the meek and the weak，不再误作“愿意”。

issues.problem: 「他后来初入京师」中的「后来」是证据未记的时间定位，英文也没有对应的词。
issues.proposed: 删去「后来」，作「他初入京师时」。
issues.rationale: 删去证据未记的“后来”，改为“左宗棠初入京师时”，与英文 When Zuo first entered the capital 对应。

issues.problem: 原文「為示諭曉」未写明是谁出的示谕，稿中写成「他示谕晓之」/'he posted a proclamation'。民间传言原文是「樓即毀矣」，英文 'would have it torn down' 加进了左宗棠的主动意图。

evidence.quote: 民間讙言左侯至，樓即毀矣，為示諭曉，乃止

issues.proposed: 中文改为「民间讙言左侯至楼即毁，后出示谕晓，乃止（原文未明言示谕者）」；英文改为 'the tower would come down once Marquis Zuo arrived; a notice was posted to explain'。
issues.rationale: 中文改为“后出示谕晓，传言乃止”，并注明原文未明言示谕者；民间传言改为直引「左侯至，樓即毀矣」。英文改为 the tower would come down once the Marquis Zuo arrived; a notice was posted，并注明未载示谕者，去掉左宗棠的主动意图。

issues.problem: 中文第二层判断以「一种解释是」标注，英文 'Zuo's objection held not because…' 没有对应标注，两版不一致。
issues.proposed: 英文改为 'One reading is that Zuo's objection held…'。
issues.rationale: 英文第二层判断前加 One reading is that，与中文“一种解释是”一致。

issues.problem: 英文正文各处引号里的内容都是从文言译出的，如 hook.0、context.0、story.0/1/4/6/7、analysis.1。但全文没有一处告诉读者这些是译文，读者容易把它们当成原文。
issues.proposed: 在英文 limits.0 加一句：'All quotations in the English text are the author's translations from the classical Chinese.'
issues.rationale: 英文 limits.0 加上说明：英文引语均为作者自文言译出；中文同步写明“英文版中的引语均为作者自文言译出”。

issues.problem: 「李鸿章」/'Li Hongzhang' 的全名不在证据中，证据只作「鴻章」，问题与 F7 同源。
issues.proposed: 改为「鸿章」/'Hongzhang'，或注明姓氏为作者所补。
issues.rationale: 中英文的“李鸿章/Li Hongzhang”改为“鸿章/Hongzhang”，并注明原文只称其名。

issues.problem: 简体中文正文里混用了繁体「托克遜」，story.5 也有同样情况。
issues.proposed: 统一为「托克逊」。

issues.problem: 英文 uncertainty_note 只说引语是史家记述，没有说明英文引语是作者译文，问题与 F20 相同。
issues.proposed: 英文补上 'English quotations are the author's translations'。
issues.rationale: 英文 uncertainty_note 补上 English quotations are the author's translations；中文同步补上“英文版引语为作者译文”。

issues.rationale: 现稿 limits.1 已作「光绪元年、二年、三年、四年、六年」，并未漏掉四年。

issues.problem: 中文写「不只看得地多少，还看事后守不守得住、辩不辩得清」，意思是两者都看。英文写成 "not by the land it gained"，变成完全排除得地多少，推断比中文更强，也更难从 E4/E10 得到支持（E4 明言要「規還國家舊所沒地」）。

evidence.quote: 不及時規還國家舊所沒地

issues.proposed: 英文改为 "…by whether it could be held afterwards and defended in argument, not only by the land it gained."
issues.rationale: 英文原作 "not by the land it gained"，等于完全排除得地多少，比中文“不只看得地多少，还看……”更强，也与左宗棠明言要收回旧地相矛盾。现将英文改为 "not only by the land it gained"，与中文语义一致。中文本身无误，按中英同步规则原文照录。

edits.before: 光绪元年，左宗棠刚平定关陇，大军正要出关，海防之议先起了。论者说，自高宗定新疆，「歲糜數百萬，此漏卮也」，如今「竭天下力贍西軍，無以待不虞」，不如照英国人的主张办：「許帕夏自立為國稱籓，罷西征，專力海防」。钱只有这么多，先停哪一头，得当场回答。
edits.after: 光绪元年，左宗棠刚平定关陇，大军正要出关，海防之议先起了。论者说，自高宗定新疆，「歲糜數百萬，此漏卮也」，如今「竭天下力贍西軍，無以待不虞」，不如照英国人的主张办：「許帕夏自立為國稱籓，罷西征，專力海防」。

edits.before: In the first year of the Guangxu reign, Zuo Zongtang had just pacified Guanlong, the Gansu–Shaanxi corridor, and his army was about to march out beyond the pass when the argument over coastal defense broke out first. Since the Qianlong emperor took Xinjiang, critics said, "several million a year have drained away, a leaky vessel"; now things had reached the point of "exhausting the strength of the whole realm to feed the western army, leaving nothing for the unforeseen." Better to do as the British proposed: "let Pasha found his own state and pay homage as a vassal, call off the western expedition, concentrate on coastal defense." There was only so much money. Which front to stop first demanded an answer on the spot.
edits.after: In the first year of the Guangxu reign, Zuo Zongtang had just pacified Guanlong, and his army was about to march out beyond the pass when the argument over coastal defense broke out first. Since the emperor Gaozong took Xinjiang, critics said, "several million a year have drained away, a leaky vessel"; now things had reached the point of "exhausting the strength of the whole realm to feed the western army, leaving nothing for the unforeseen." Better to do as the British proposed: "let Pasha found his own state and pay homage as a vassal, call off the western expedition, concentrate on coastal defense."

edits.before: Before judging whether to stop, look at what the western spending was protecting. The Muslim chief beyond the frontier whom the biography calls Pasha — a title, roughly governor — was by origin a hoşbeg, or clan chief, of the Andijan. Andijan had belonged to Kokand; Russia destroyed Kokand, and Andijan alone survived. Pasha, the record says, "feared Russian pressure and slipped across the border." Inside it he took Kashgar, nibbled away at the eight southern cities, and defeated Tuo Ming, the Muslim holding Ürümqi, so that he also possessed the Ili cities of the north and took their taxes. He commanded the Muslim population, kept envoys moving to draw in British and Russian support, and bought arms: "The English secretly helped him, wishing to set him up as a separate state, to serve as a buffer against Russia."

Inside it he took Kashgar, nibbled away at the eight southern cities, and defeated Tuo Ming, the Muslim holding Ürümqi, so that he also possessed the Ili cities of the north and took their taxes. He commanded the Muslim population, kept envoys moving to draw in British and Russian support, and bought arms: "The English secretly helped him, wishing to set him up as a separate state, to serve as a buffer against Russia."

edits.before: 北边动手更快。俄以回数扰其边境，引兵逐回，取伊犁，且言将代取乌鲁木齐。也就是说，到光绪元年，伊犁已在俄国手中，乌鲁木齐也在其口头计划之内。
edits.after: 北边动手更快。传记记为「當是時」，未系具体年份：俄以回数扰其边境，遽引兵逐回，取伊犁，且言将代取乌鲁木齐。

edits.before: The north moved faster. Because the Muslims had raided its border repeatedly, Russia sent troops to drive them out, took Ili, and announced it would take Ürümqi too. By the first year of Guangxu, then, Ili was in Russian hands, and Ürümqi sat inside Russia's stated plans.
edits.after: The north moved faster. The biography dates this only as "at that time," without naming a year: because the Muslims had repeatedly raided its border, Russia promptly sent troops to drive them out, took Ili, and said it would also take Ürümqi on China's behalf.

edits.before: 海防一派的主张写得直白：西征是填不满的漏卮，海上一旦有事将无以应对，不如许帕夏自立为国、向中国称籓，把力量全数转去海防。传记说「鴻章言之尤力」，却没有记下鸿章本人的具体论据；赞成一方的理由在史料里仅存「論者多言」一段概述。
edits.after: 海防一派的主张写得直白：西征是填不满的漏卮，一旦有不虞之事将无以应对，不如许帕夏自立为国、向中国称籓，把力量全数转去海防。传记说「鴻章言之尤力」，却没有记下鸿章本人的具体论据；赞成一方的理由在史料里仅存「論者多言」一段概述。

edits.before: The coastal-defense case was stated flatly: the expedition was a vessel with a hole in it, and if trouble came at sea there would be nothing to meet it with. Better to let Pasha set up a tributary state and turn every resource to the coast. The biography says "Li Hongzhang pressed this hardest of all," but records none of Li Hongzhang's own specific arguments; for that side of the debate, the record preserves only one summary paragraph of the proponents' case.
edits.after: The coastal-defense case was stated flatly: the expedition was a vessel with a hole in it, and if anything unforeseen came, nothing would be left to meet it. Better to let Pasha set up a tributary state and turn every resource to the coast. The biography says "Hongzhang pressed this hardest of all" (the record gives only the name Hongzhang), but records none of his own specific arguments; for that side of the debate, the record preserves only one summary paragraph of the proponents' case.

edits.before: 左宗棠的反驳不在道德，而在账。他认为割弃不等于省钱：关陇新平，不趁势收回旧地，反而让帕夏另立一国，是坐自遗患；帕夏若守不住，地不是归英就是入俄，地盘坐缩，边防要地尽失，防边的兵也减不掉。传记记其言：「關隴新平，不及時規還國家舊所沒地，而割棄使別為國，此坐自遺患。萬一帕夏不能有，不西為英並，即北折而入俄耳。吾地坐縮，邊要盡失，防邊兵不可減，糜餉自若。無益海防而挫國威，且長亂。此必不可。」要害在中段：兵减不掉，饷照旧要花。
edits.after: 作者认为，左宗棠的反驳重心在账上，不过原话里也有「挫國威」这样的非财务理由。他认为割弃不等于省钱：关陇新平，不趁势收回旧地，反而让帕夏另立一国，是坐自遗患；帕夏若守不住，地不是归英就是入俄，地盘坐缩，边防要地尽失，防边的兵也减不掉。传记记其言：「關隴新平，不及時規還國家舊所沒地，而割棄使別為國，此坐自遺患。萬一帕夏不能有，不西為英並，即北折而入俄耳。吾地坐縮，邊要盡失，防邊兵不可減，糜餉自若。無益海防而挫國威，且長亂。此必不可。」要害在中段：兵减不掉，饷照旧要花。

edits.before: Zuo's answer was arithmetic, not moral: carving territory loose did not save money: the territory would only shrink, every strategic point be lost, and the frontier troops could not be cut. The biography gives his words: "Guanlong has only just been pacified. Instead of recovering the lands the state once lost, we carve them off and let another state be founded there — that is to store up trouble of our own making. Should Pasha fail to hold them, they will be swallowed by England in the west or fold north into Russia. Our territory shrinks of its own accord, every strategic point is lost, the frontier troops cannot be reduced, and the spending goes on as before. It does nothing for coastal defense, it damages our prestige, and it feeds disorder. This must not be." The sting is in the middle: the troops cannot be cut, and the money flows out all the same.
edits.after: One reading is that Zuo's answer rested chiefly on cost, though his words also cite damage to the state's prestige. Carving territory loose, he argued, did not save money: it stored up trouble, and if Pasha failed to hold the land it would fall to England or to Russia; the territory would shrink, every strategic point be lost, and the frontier troops could not be cut. The biography gives his words: "Guanlong has only just been pacified. Instead of recovering in good time the lands the state once lost, we carve them off and let another state be founded there — that is to store up trouble of our own making. Should Pasha fail to hold them, they will be swallowed by England in the west or fold north into Russia. Our territory shrinks of its own accord, every strategic point is lost, the frontier troops cannot be reduced, and the spending goes on as before. It does nothing for coastal defense, it damages our prestige, and it feeds disorder. This must not be." The sting is in the middle: the troops cannot be cut, and the money flows out all the same.

edits.before: 争论的结局很短。军机大臣文祥独善宗棠议，遂决策出塞，不罢兵，授左宗棠钦差大臣督军事，金顺副之。传记只记文祥一人赞成，未记其理由。
edits.after: 关于争论如何收场，传记记得很简短。军机大臣文祥独善宗棠议，遂决策出塞，不罢兵，授左宗棠钦差大臣督军事，金顺副之。传记只记文祥一人赞成，未记其理由。

edits.before: The dispute ended quickly. Wenxiang, a Grand Council minister, was the only one to favor Zuo's plan; the decision went to march beyond the pass rather than disband, with Zuo named Imperial Commissioner for military affairs and Jin Shun as his deputy. The biography records only that Wenxiang agreed, and no reason why.
edits.after: The record of how it ended is brief. The biography records only that Wenxiang agreed, and no reason why.

edits.before: The call to stop came a second time. The minister at Khüree, in Urga, reported that the western question should be settled by fixing a frontier, and courtiers argued the expedition cost too much: with Ürümqi and Turpan in hand, the army could rest. Zuo sighed: "The moment offers an opening — and we would settle for drawing lines on the map and shrinking back?" He sent up a forceful memorial against it; the throne agreed.

edits.before: 还有一层分寸。时俄方与土耳其战，金顺请乘虚袭伊犁，宗棠曰：「不可。師不以正，彼有辭矣。」随后大军还定乌什，收南疆东四城，何步云以喀什汉城降，西四城相继下，伯克胡里与白彦虎遁走俄，诏晋二等侯。
edits.after: 还有一层分寸。时俄方与土耳其战，金顺请乘虚袭伊犁，宗棠曰：「不可。師不以正，彼有辭矣。」随后大军还定乌什，收南疆东四城，何步云以喀什汉城降；伯克胡里既纳白彦虎，乃效力攻汉城，大军至，复遁走俄；西四城相继下，宗棠露布以闻，诏晋二等侯。

edits.before: There was also the matter of restraint. Russia was then at war with Turkey, and Jin Shun asked leave to strike Ili while it lay open. "No," said Zuo. "An army that does not act by right hands them their excuse." The army turned back to reduce Ushi, then took the four eastern cities of the south; He Buyun surrendered the Chinese city of Kashgar, and the four western cities fell in turn. Bokhuli and Bai Yanhu escaped into Russia, and Zuo was raised to a second-class marquis.
edits.after: There was also the matter of restraint. Russia was then at war with Turkey, and Jin Shun asked leave to strike Ili while it lay open. "No," said Zuo. "An army that does not act by right hands them their excuse." The army turned back to reduce Ushi, then took the four eastern cities of the south, and He Buyun surrendered the Chinese city of Kashgar. Bokhuli, having taken in Bai Yanhu, then threw his strength against that Chinese city; when the army arrived, he fled again into Russia. The four western cities fell in turn; Zuo announced the victory by public dispatch, and an edict raised him to second-class marquis.

edits.before: Set side by side, the two lines show one test: recover the ground, but leave no handle for the other side. In the first year of Guangxu the fear was that cession would damage prestige and feed disorder; here, that an army acting without right would hand Russia its excuse. One reading is that he judged a move by whether it could be held afterwards and defended in argument, not by the land it gained. The biography draws no such conclusion.

In the first year of Guangxu the fear was that cession would damage prestige and feed disorder; here, that an army acting without right would hand Russia its excuse. One reading is that he judged a move by whether it could be held afterwards and defended in argument, not by the land it gained. The biography draws no such conclusion.

edits.before: With north and south recovered, the question shifted from whether to fight to how to hold. In the first month of the fourth year Zuo laid out plans to make Xinjiang a regular province and asked that Russia be negotiated with over two things: the return of Ili and the surrender of fugitives. An Imperial Commissioner, Chong Hou, was sent to Russia. Russia pressed three demands — trade, boundaries, indemnity — and Chong Hou signed at once. Court officials impeached him, and the matter stayed open for a long time.
edits.after: With north and south recovered, the question shifted from whether to fight to how to hold. In the first month of the fourth year Zuo laid out plans to make Xinjiang a regular province and asked that Russia be negotiated with over two things: the return of Ili and the surrender of fugitives. A plenipotentiary envoy, Chong Hou, was sent to Russia. Russia pressed three demands — trade, boundaries, indemnity — and Chong Hou signed at once. Court officials impeached him, and the matter stayed open for a long time.

edits.before: Chong Hou was disgraced and removed, and Zeng Jize sent to Russia to revise the treaty. Zuo asked to move out to Hami to prepare the recovery of Ili. In the fourth month of the sixth year he set out from Suzhou "carrying his coffin" — meaning to die on campaign — and reached Hami in the fifth. Russia, hearing the imperial army was moving in force, reinforced Ili and the Naryn and put warships to sea to shake the capital; Tianjin, Fengtian and Shandong were all on alert. In the seventh month Zuo was summoned to the capital as an adviser, with Jintang replacing him; the biography says Russia too was cowed by our military prestige. In the first month of the following year peace was concluded, Ili returned, and the coastal forces stood down.

Russia, hearing the imperial army was moving in force, reinforced Ili and the Naryn and put warships to sea to shake the capital; Tianjin, Fengtian and Shandong were all on alert. In the seventh month Zuo was summoned to the capital as an adviser, with Jintang replacing him; the biography says Russia too was cowed by our military prestige. In the first month of the following year peace was concluded, Ili returned, and the coastal forces stood down.

edits.before: In practice the ledger came down to logistics. Zuo "was quick to judge the moment in war and never kept to one set of tactics," and in western affairs he made saving troops and filling the stores his first principle. Twenty months beyond the pass, and every city in north and south recovered: the biography credits the abundance of supply. There was garrison farming too. He argued for military colonies early on and was thought pedantic; then he set out the abuses of the old garrisons inside and outside the pass — men on the army rolls who could not also farm — and proposed dividing the two, keeping the strong as soldiers, settling the willing and the weak on the land. Then people respected the long view behind it.

He argued for military colonies early on and was thought pedantic; then he set out the abuses of the old garrisons inside and outside the pass — men on the army rolls who could not also farm — and proposed dividing the two, keeping the strong as soldiers, settling the meek and the weak on the land. Then people respected the long view behind it.

edits.before: 仗打赢之后，外部的看法也变了。国家承平久，武备弛不振，海外诸国虽见中国屡平大难，仍私议以为脆弱；及宗棠平帕夏，外国乃稍稍传说之。他后来初入京师，内城有教堂高楼俯瞰宫殿，民间讙言左侯至楼即毁，他示谕晓之，乃止。

edits.before: After the victories, opinion abroad shifted. The empire had been at peace so long that its armaments had gone slack, and the overseas powers, talking of wealth and strength among themselves, still whispered that China was frail even after it had put down one great crisis after another. Once Zuo had dealt with Pasha, the foreigners began to spread the word about him. On his first arrival in the capital, a church tower in the Inner City overlooked the palace, and popular rumor said the Marquis Zuo would have it torn down; he posted a proclamation to explain, and the talk stopped.
edits.after: After the victories, opinion abroad shifted. The empire had been at peace so long that its armaments had gone slack, and the overseas powers, talking of wealth and strength among themselves, still whispered that China was frail even after it had put down one great crisis after another. Once Zuo had dealt with Pasha, the foreigners began to spread the word about him. When Zuo first entered the capital, a church tower in the Inner City overlooked the palace, and popular rumor had it that the tower would come down once the Marquis Zuo arrived; a notice was posted to explain, and the talk stopped. The record does not say who issued the notice.

edits.before: The author's reading is that unpacking that first-year argument yields three reusable tests: can what you were protecting still be held once you stop? Is the money you save actually saved? Does the cost of delay simply pass to whoever comes next? Zuo's objection held not because the expedition was worth more, but because cession left the cost structure untouched — less territory, the same troops, the same spending, and trouble added. That is the author's summary; the biography records events only.

issues.problem: 中文写「不只看得地多少，还看事后守不守得住、辩不辩得清」，意思是两者都看。英文写成 "not by the land it gained"，变成完全排除得地多少，推断比中文更强，也更难从 E4/E10 得到支持（E4 明言要「規還國家舊所沒地」）。

evidence.quote: 本安集延部之和碩伯克也

issues.proposed: 删去这两处释义，只保留音译 'Pasha' 和 'hoşbeg'。

issues.problem: 原文是「且言將代取烏魯木齊」，「代取」指俄方声称代为攻取。中文改成「乌鲁木齐也在其口头计划之内」，英文写成 'would take Ürümqi too'，都抹掉了「代」字，把它写成了俄国自己的占地计划。
issues.proposed: 中文改为「且言将代取乌鲁木齐」，删去「也在其口头计划之内」；英文改为 'and said it would take Ürümqi on China's behalf'。

issues.problem: 「到光绪元年，伊犁已在俄国手中」/'By the first year of Guangxu' 把时间点写成了定论。原文只作「當是時」，并未系年。

evidence.quote: 當是時，俄以回數擾其邊境，遽引兵逐回，取伊犁

issues.proposed: 改为「传记记为『当是时』，未系具体年份」/'The biography dates this only as "at that time"'。

issues.problem: 「海上一旦有事将无以应对」/'if trouble came at sea' 把「不虞」限定成了海上之事，原文泛指不测。
issues.proposed: 中文改为「一旦有不虞之事将无以应对」；英文改为 'nothing would be left to meet the unforeseen'。

issues.problem: 证据只作「鴻章」，英文补出了姓氏 Li Hongzhang，这超出了证据。
issues.proposed: 英文改为 'Hongzhang' 并注明原文只称其名，或删去姓氏。

issues.problem: 「反驳不在道德，而在账」/'arithmetic, not moral' 是作者判断，没有标为解释。而且原话里本有「挫國威」这一非财务理由，与「不在道德」的说法并不完全相符。

evidence.quote: 無益海防而挫國威，且長亂

issues.proposed: 改为「作者认为，他的反驳重心在账上」/'One reading is that his answer rested chiefly on cost'。

issues.problem: 英文概述漏了中文所含的「坐自遗患」和「帕夏守不住则归英入俄」两层意思。英文译文 'Instead of recovering' 也漏译了「不及時」。

evidence.quote: 不及時規還國家舊所沒地

issues.proposed: 英文概述补上 'storing up trouble, and the land would fall to England or Russia if Pasha failed'；译文改为 'Instead of recovering in good time the lands…'。

issues.problem: 英文 'The dispute ended quickly' 是时长判断，证据未记，中文「结局很短」也没有这层意思。另外 'rather than disband' 误译了「不罷兵」，原意是不停兵。
issues.proposed: 改为 'The record of how it ended is brief'，并把 'rather than disband' 改为 'rather than halt the campaign'。

issues.problem: 英文 'The minister at Khüree, in Urga' 加了地名对应注释，证据只作「庫倫大臣」。

evidence.quote: 適庫倫大臣上言西事宜畫定疆界

issues.proposed: 改为 'The minister at Kulun (Khüree)'，删去 'in Urga'。

issues.problem: 原文顺序是：何步云降，伯克胡里纳白彦虎后攻汉城，大军至后遁走俄，然后西四城相继下。稿中把遁走俄移到西四城下之后，并略去了伯克胡里攻汉城一事。原文遁走俄的主语是伯克胡里，稿中明写白彦虎同逃，属于推断。

evidence.quote: 伯克胡里既納白彥虎，乃效力攻漢城。大軍至，复遁走俄。西四城相繼下

issues.proposed: 按原序改为「何步云以喀什汉城降；伯克胡里既纳白彦虎，攻汉城，大军至，遁走俄；西四城相继下」，英文同步调整。

issues.problem: 英文首句 'Set side by side, the two lines show one test' 直接写成断言。中文对应句以「作者推断」开头，英文缺少这一标注。
issues.proposed: 英文改为 'The author's inference is that, set side by side, the two lines show one test…'。

issues.problem: 英文把「全權大臣」译为 'An Imperial Commissioner'。该词稿中已用来对应左宗棠的「欽差大臣」，这样会混淆两种官职。

evidence.quote: 詔遣全權大臣崇厚使俄

issues.proposed: 改为 'A plenipotentiary, Chonghou, was sent to Russia'。

issues.problem: 英文 'meaning to die on campaign' 替左宗棠补写了动机，证据只记「輿櫬」。这也与 limits.0 所称「没有补写心理动机」相矛盾。
issues.proposed: 删去 'meaning to die on campaign'。

issues.problem: 英文把「願弱」译为 'the willing and the weak'。「願」在此当谨厚、朴弱讲，并非「愿意」。
issues.proposed: 改为 'settling the meek and the weak on the land'。

issues.problem: 「他后来初入京师」中的「后来」是证据未记的时间定位，英文也没有对应的词。
issues.proposed: 删去「后来」，作「他初入京师时」。

issues.problem: 原文「為示諭曉」未写明是谁出的示谕，稿中写成「他示谕晓之」/'he posted a proclamation'。民间传言原文是「樓即毀矣」，英文 'would have it torn down' 加进了左宗棠的主动意图。

evidence.quote: 民間讙言左侯至，樓即毀矣，為示諭曉，乃止

issues.proposed: 中文改为「民间讙言左侯至楼即毁，后出示谕晓，乃止（原文未明言示谕者）」；英文改为 'the tower would come down once Marquis Zuo arrived; a notice was posted to explain'。

issues.problem: 中文第二层判断以「一种解释是」标注，英文 'Zuo's objection held not because…' 没有对应标注，两版不一致。
issues.proposed: 英文改为 'One reading is that Zuo's objection held…'。

issues.problem: 英文正文各处引号里的内容都是从文言译出的，如 hook.0、context.0、story.0/1/4/6/7、analysis.1。但全文没有一处告诉读者这些是译文，读者容易把它们当成原文。
issues.proposed: 在英文 limits.0 加一句：'All quotations in the English text are the author's translations from the classical Chinese.'

issues.problem: 「李鸿章」/'Li Hongzhang' 的全名不在证据中，证据只作「鴻章」，问题与 F7 同源。
issues.proposed: 改为「鸿章」/'Hongzhang'，或注明姓氏为作者所补。

issues.problem: 简体中文正文里混用了繁体「托克遜」，story.5 也有同样情况。
issues.proposed: 统一为「托克逊」。

issues.problem: 英文 uncertainty_note 只说引语是史家记述，没有说明英文引语是作者译文，问题与 F20 相同。
issues.proposed: 英文补上 'English quotations are the author's translations'。
